subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should yielded parent completion be solved as one cross-runtime yield-wait lifecycle/ack contract, or should maintainers land only the current narrow ACP/task-registry and subagent give-up slices while tracking the remaining native cases separately?
rationale: Current main has several partial repairs and open candidate PRs, but the permanent boundary affects session-state, message delivery, and when delivery is credited as processed rather than merely queued.

options.title: Define Cross-Runtime Contract
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical place to specify yield-wait state, wake source requirements, and completion consumption/ack semantics before landing more broad fixes.

options.title: Land Narrow Slices
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95776 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95080 as scoped repairs while keeping this issue open for the remaining contract.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Move each remaining ACP/native/heartbeat/ack failure mode to narrower canonical issues and close this only after every slice is either fixed or explicitly rejected.

recommendation.title: Define Cross-Runtime Contract
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical place to specify yield-wait state, wake source requirements, and completion consumption/ack semantics before landing more broad fixes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history ties vincentkoc to active-parent wake and silent-handoff fixes in the central subagent delivery module.
